event.encoding: Strict canonical ASCII JSON, no LF; canonical padded base64 of complete signed wire envelope

ack.encoding: Same canonical wrapper, independently authority-verified complete signed commit ACK bytes

trusted_inputs: Explicit concrete AdmissionAuthority, immutable canonical parent_tool_binding bytes containing context,parent_identity_sha256,parent_boot_id,parent_process_id, separately enrolled ACK issuer+protected signing callable. No discovered/queue-supplied keys. Bind full context to actual canonical WORKER_LAUNCH claim/request/frame and actual spec/admission/route; response public key must match parent identity; ACK key must differ from request and parent/root keys.
ordering: Canonical claim/readback then verified CLAIM ACK. Canonical exact outcome/readback then verified OUTCOME ACK only RETURNED. Existing accepted state yields only same-operation readback/attestation, not new claim or effect. Missing/error/UNKNOWN/stale/revoked/conflicting/late events never release a result or become completion.
filesystem: Traverse pinned queue directory descriptors with no-follow, bounded regular-file reads; exact exclusive ACK publication from fsynced temporary bytes, exclusive hard link and directory fsync. Never overwrite a preexisting ACK; verify exact stored ACK instead. Files transport only, never authority.
scope_limits: No parent file read/tool invocation, CLI/provider, authority/broker/fence/installer edits, production enrollment or permit; final launch response/fence flow remains otherwise intact.
missing_inputs: No interactive events allowed; default transport denial/legacy final-response semantics preserved.
